propositions: The committed .bridge_state cache grows ~1 GiB (92% of tickets branch) due to unchanged bookkeeping fields baseline_advanced_at and last_get_pass being scattered edits across bindings.json defeating git delta compression.
Marginal packed cost per bindings.json version is 12.79 KB today but reduces to 1.74 KB after removing baseline_advanced_at timestamp and 12.8x total after moving rotation bookkeeping out-of-line.
The reconciler runs on ephemeral GitHub-hosted runners requiring durable state to live in git, so the cache must remain committed rather than re-homed off-branch.

Deleting baseline_advanced_at, moving last_get_pass to .bridge_state/get_rotation.json with mixed-version read compatibility, and narrowing prev_snapshot.json to key-set format reduces churn without relocating the cache.

A history-strip rewrite using git fast-export/filter/fast-import reduces the branch from 1.17 GiB to 98.8 MB (8.4%) while preserving all 49,888 commits, with dynamic re-add restoring byte-identical HEAD tree.
Quiesced publication with fail-closed epoch guards, off-repo backup bundle, and operator attestation of zero sessions/stopped MCP servers gates the one-time reclaim operation.
